+def _is_child_path(path, root, link_target=None):
+    """Whether path (or a link at path) resolves inside root.
+
+    Both arguments may be bytes or text. Resolve existing symlinks so a path
+    below a linked parent cannot escape the collection directory.
+    """
+    if link_target is not None:
+        path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(path), link_target)
+    root = os.path.realpath(root)
+    path = os.path.realpath(path)
+    relative = os.path.relpath(path, root)
+    parent = to_bytes(os.pardir) if isinstance(relative, bytes) else os.pardir
+    separator = to_bytes(os.path.sep) if isinstance(relative, bytes) else os.path.sep
+    return relative != parent and not relative.startswith(parent + separator)
+
